case.summary: On 2016-12-07 21:38:37, transaction 3523199 for $100.07 on card C02923-K1 was flagged due to a model risk score of 0.54 involving a new device profile. The conclusion is that the transaction is legitimate with a fraud probability of 0.03, representing unusual but genuine cardholder behavior. The evidence rests on the $100.07 amount sitting comfortably within the card's baseline across 90 prior transactions (median $117.01) as an isolated anomaly without structural corroboration, alongside four out of five similar historical cases resolving as cleared. What remains uncertain is the origin of the unrecognised device profile, the mismatch between the purchaser domain icloud.com and recipient domain gmail.com, and the presence of 10 confirmed-fraud cases within two hops of the account.
